adds.name: convolution length
adds.meaning: the number of coefficients, the product of the prime source lengths

root.salient: The logarithmic factor is beaten by a strict power, $(\lg n)^{-\kappa}$, although the exponent $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is astronomically small.

adds.name: input length
adds.meaning: the number of bits of each of the two integers

adds.name: saving exponent
adds.meaning: the fixed constant $2^{-182}$ by which the power of $\lg n$ falls below one
